topic: How Amazon sets the BFCM deal price
detail: The BFCM deal price is the lower of (a) the lowest deal price still inside the lookback window and (b) 15% below Amazon's reference price at that point. A deal run inside the lookback forces the BFCM deal at least 5% below it. Amazon sets the reference the day before the deal. Team decision Oct 15: cancel most pre-BFCM deals unless the reference already equals the current price (Erik Fisher).

38 SKUs raised +6% to +15% on Oct 10 with 2-9 day holds. 2-day, 3-day and 4-day holds all failed (no STR after revert, even with paid orders).
